name: Sandia Technical Reference for Hydrogen Compatibility of Materials
description: Reference chapters compile deformation, fracture and fatigue evidence for hydrogen service; archive SAND2012-7321 (2012) and individually revised chapters. Downloadable PDF verified. Chapters are not independent material records; the complementary structured database currently says under construction, with a new Granta MI link planned for Fall 2026. No collection-specific data reuse license verified.

sources.title: Sandia reference collection
sources.evidence: Primary page links archival report and dated alloy/polymer chapters; scientific scope is hydrogen-affected strength, fracture and fatigue.

sources.title: Complementary database current access
sources.evidence: States database is under construction and a new Granta MI link will be available Fall 2026; no current structured download verified.

name: NIST Property Data Summaries for Advanced Materials (SRD 150)
description: Condition-specific literature property summaries, including alumina, silicon carbide and titanium diboride. The alumina table documents units, temperatures, material purity/density and uncertainty notation. Data content last updated 2002; derived summaries overlap SRD30 and topical databases and should not be added to their counts. No open redistribution license verified; portal states copyright/all rights reserved.

sources.title: SRD150 sintered-alumina example
sources.evidence: Validated summary gives material scope, property values by temperature, combined standard uncertainty notation and SRD30/literature references.

sources.title: SRD150 scope and access
sources.evidence: Provides public reference summaries and links topical collections; evaluation levels vary across typical, evaluated and validated data.

name: ACerS-NIST Phase Equilibria Diagrams Database (SRD 31)
description: Version 6.0 (2025) provides 34,000 phase-equilibrium diagrams with expert literature evaluations for inorganic systems. Current primary page offers paid single/multiple-user products and directs Phase Online orders to ACerS. Diagram totals are not unique materials; joint NIST/ACerS copyright and commercial access preclude describing this as an open data download. Free PED Editor software is separate from database access.

sources.title: SRD31 current product and release
sources.evidence: Current NIST page documents v6.0 (2025), 34,000 diagrams, expert critical evaluations and paid products.
